notes.title: May 22 Patch Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In this update, we’ve fixed several issues reported in the game. Thank you for your feedback and suggestions!

---Synthetic Captive Team

Bug Fixes:

1. Fixed an issue with abnormal mouse speed for some players.
2. Adjusted certain quest flows.
3. Fixed issues with abnormal text display.

Follow us for more updates:
Synthetic Captive Official Discord: https://discord.gg/Vu3ksYM
